Option O1 references missing risk Long-horizon implementations may exceed token/time budgets due to serialized execution.
Option O1 references missing risk Linear accumulation of artifacts can pressure context-window bounds if context-pack selection is not strict.
Option O1 references missing risk Flaky validator behavior can exhaust retry budgets and stall the only active lane.
Option O2 references missing risk Merge conflicts between lanes may be frequent in tightly-coupled repos, driving escalation rates.
Option O2 references missing risk Missed dependencies in task partitioning can cause late integration failures and rework.
Option O2 references missing risk Reproducibility depends on merge ordering rules that must be independent of wall-clock completion timing.
Option O2 references missing risk Workspace partition boundaries can be violated by side-effecting tools unless sandboxing and path scoping are strict.
Option O3 references missing risk Validation cost may pressure teams to weaken regression gates, reducing safety.
Option O3 references missing risk Environment drift between runs can break deterministic replay/resume unless toolchains are pinned.
Option O3 references missing risk Budget thresholds for partial-freeze decisions can be misestimated, freezing too early/late.
Option O3 references missing risk Task ordering may hide implicit dependencies that cause late-task failures.
Option O4 references missing risk Internal complexity may grow and undermine CNS12 separation (reviewers/judges becoming entangled with writing/patching).
Option O4 references missing risk Hidden internal state transitions can make checkpoint/resume and traceability less explicit unless the monolith emits full stage_handoff artifacts.
Option O4 references missing risk Monolith becomes a high-blast-radius component for failures and changes.
Decision reference missing: Use O2 fan-out/fan-in with a deterministic integration sub-flow (C18–C21) as the governing pattern for parallelism, rather than purely sequential execution (O1).

Decision reference missing: Adopt a hybrid rollout: start with a single-lane foundation to validate governance (audit spine, workspace rules, permissions, evidence pointers, secrets policy), then add parallel lanes, then add deterministic integration merge ordering and conflict escalation.

Decision reference missing: Enforce namespaced workspace partitions (C22) per lane plus a shared canonical integration partition, with unified workspace_index.json accounting across partitions (R17–R18).

Decision reference missing: Define deterministic merge ordering independent of wall-clock lane completion timing (K12), recorded as a canonical ordering artifact produced by the orchestrator/integration engine.

Decision reference missing: Maintain high HITL strictness for parallel execution, with mandatory escalation for protected-path touches, secrets detection, critical security findings, and merge conflicts beyond deterministic thresholds (tool_policy + hitl_policy).

Decision reference missing: Gate progress by phase-specific acceptance test subsets, culminating in full AT suite before final Freeze; integration-specific determinism is explicitly acceptance-gated in Phase 3/4 (AT15 + integration merge determinism check).
